column1: # ZAP rules for the API scan (scripts/dast.sh, make dast).
# Tab separated: plugin id, level, (rule name), reason.
# Unlisted rules follow the alert's risk: High and Medium FAIL, Low WARN,
# Informational INFO (scripts/zap_gate.py). A line here overrides that for one
# rule. IGNORE, INFO and WARN need a reason. IGNORE also stops ZAP running an
# active rule. To drop only some URLs: <id>\tOUTOFSCOPE\t<url regex>.
# Django's HTML 404 page, for URLs ZAP makes up that match no route. With
# DEBUG off it holds no detail (no route list). Every real API route answers
# JSON. Kept as INFO so it still shows in the report.

column4: Django's plain HTML 404 for unrouted paths ZAP invents; DEBUG is off so it discloses nothing, and API routes answer JSON.

column1: # The nearest-station answer includes OpenStreetMap ids (osm_id), and ten-digit
# ones look like Unix times from 2018-2019. Only these two read-only
# reference-data endpoints are excluded; a timestamp anywhere else still warns.
# DOM XSS needs a page that runs JavaScript in a browser; every API route
# answers JSON. ZAP starts a headless browser for it, which took over two
# minutes per run and once took ZAP down with it.

column4: The API serves JSON only, no HTML pages with scripts, so there is no DOM to inject into; the Flutter web app isn't part of this scan.
